subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: When a PRD, design, or currency-disposition PR would merge, the gate shall run the five checks over the affected feature's candidate contract as a CI context, reporting currency, link-resolution, structural, and disposition-integrity defects as blocking and inverse-coverage defects as advisory.
rationale: the record that can clear a critical currency edge must be validated before activation, while a PRD legitimately merges before its serving designs exist
fit_criterion: fixture PRs seeding a currency/link/structural defect or malformed/expired/unauthorized disposition fail the context; a valid exact disposition clears only its edge; a coverage-only gap remains advisory; a clean PR passes
